nodes.label: SilverChat Infrastructure Stack
nodes.rationale: Locked zero-cost MVP stack combining Supabase (DB/Auth/Storage/Realtime), LiveKit Cloud (voice/video calls), Resend (transactional magic-link email), and Netlify (frontend hosting) with a billing-only upgrade path to ~10,000 concurrent users.

nodes.label: Billing-Only Scaling Strategy (0 to 10k Users)
nodes.rationale: Ensures transitioning from ~3 prototype users to ~10,000 concurrent users requires only upgrading provider billing plans without rewriting backend or frontend code, while maintaining pg_dump Postgres portability.

nodes.label: LiveKit Token Generation Edge Function
nodes.rationale: LiveKit requires server-signed JWT access tokens that cannot be generated safely in the browser; a ~30-line Supabase Edge Function handles on-demand token generation.
